system.description: You can substitute a Use Computer check for a Mechanics check when disabling a computerized device. The effort takes 1 minute and the DC is equal to the computer's Will Defense. In addition, whenever anyone accesses the afflicted computer using a Droid or another computer, that computer or Droid's Attitude immediately becomes Unfriendly.

prerequisite.text: Electronic Sabotage talent, and Trained in Use Computer
